definition: Population is List ℝ: each entry is one individual on a stipulated common cardinal interpersonal welfare scale. Length is count, total sums welfare and mean divides total by count. Summary requires strictly positive count and reuses the old Profile; its total is proved equal to the individual sum. Empty average is an arithmetic extension only; ranking statements use nonempty guards. Positive average does not imply each entry positive.
